_about: Checked-in reference environment for omop-duck-db releases and multi-site benchmark studies (0.36.0, M3). Pinned runtimes (python, R, quarto) come from Dockerfile; library versions record the verified study container (ghcr.io/jkylearmstrong/omop-duck-db:0.31.0, confirmed against run C22's Study_Manuscript.bib) against which site and CI environments are compared via scripts/check_env.py.
